concept.title: Referral required
concept.shortdesc: Needing to be referred to the service by a professional, whether any agency or a health or care professional.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Referral through any professional or agency, or a choice between self-referral and professional referral.
: Needing referral by a health or care professional, such as a healthcare worker, clinician or social prescriber.
